slowest.sql: select * from `disaster_events` where `deleted_at` is null and `ended_at` is null order by `started_at` desc limit 1

select * from (select `team_id`, `assignment_id`, `responder_id`, `assigned_area`, `assigned_at`, `status`, `route_notes`, `outcome_notes`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY assigned_at DESC, assignment_id DESC) as row_rank from `responder_assignments` where `disaster_id` = ? and `team_id` in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) and `status` not in (?, ?)) as `ranked_assignments` where `row_rank` = ?

select a.sitio_id as address_sitio_id, p.sitio_id as purok_sitio_id, a.purok_id as address_purok_id, a.purok_sitio as address_label, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as total_members, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ms.status_key IS NULL OR ms.status_key IN ('unknown','unchecked','unreported') THEN m.member_id END) as unreported_members, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.is_pwd = 1 OR m.is_senior = 1 OR m.is_pregnant = 1 OR EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM member_vulnerable_groups g WHERE g.member_id = m.member_id) OR (m.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND m.birth_date > '2008-10-13') THEN m.member_id END) as total_vulnerable_members, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (m.is_pwd = 1 OR m.is_senior = 1 OR m.is_pregnant = 1 OR EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM member_vulnerable_groups g WHERE g.member_id = m.member_id) OR (m.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND m.birth_date > '2008-10-13'))
                AND (ms.status_key IS NULL OR ms.status_key NOT IN ('safe','safe_at_home','evacuated'))
                THEN m.member_id END) as unresolved_vulnerable_members from `household_members` as `m` inner join `households` as `h` on `h`.`household_id` = `m`.`household_id` inner join `addresses` as `a` on `a`.`address_id` = `h`.`address_id` left join `puroks` as `p` on `p`.`purok_id` = `a`.`purok_id` left join `member_disaster_statuses` as `report` on `report`.`member_id` = `m`.`member_id` and `report`.`disaster_id` = ? left join `member_statuses` as `ms` on `ms`.`status_id` = `report`.`status_id` where `a`.`purok_id` in (select `eligible_purok`.`purok_id` from `puroks` as `eligible_purok` inner join `sitios` as `eligible_sitio` on `eligible_sitio`.`sitio_id` = `eligible_purok`.`sitio_id` where `eligible_sitio`.`barangay_id` = ?) and `h`.`deleted_at` is null and `m`.`deleted_at` is null group by `a`.`sitio_id`, `p`.`sitio_id`, `a`.`purok_id`, `a`.`purok_sitio`

select `address_sitio_id`, `purok_sitio_id`, `address_purok_id`, `address_label`, `reported_status_key`, COUNT(*) as household_total from (select `a`.`sitio_id` as `address_sitio_id`, `p`.`sitio_id` as `purok_sitio_id`, `a`.`purok_id` as `address_purok_id`, `a`.`purok_sitio` as `address_label`, (select `status`.`status_key` from `household_status_logs` as `report` inner join `household_statuses` as `status` on `status`.`status_id` = `report`.`status_id` where `report`.`household_id` = `h`.`household_id` and `report`.`disaster_id` = ? and `status`.`status_key` in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) order by `report`.`submitted_at` desc, `report`.`status_log_id` desc limit 1) as `reported_status_key` from `households` as `h` inner join `addresses` as `a` on `a`.`address_id` = `h`.`address_id` left join `puroks` as `p` on `p`.`purok_id` = `a`.`purok_id` where `a`.`purok_id` in (select `eligible_purok`.`purok_id` from `puroks` as `eligible_purok` inner join `sitios` as `eligible_sitio` on `eligible_sitio`.`sitio_id` = `eligible_purok`.`sitio_id` where `eligible_sitio`.`barangay_id` = ?) and `h`.`deleted_at` is null) as `area_status` group by `address_sitio_id`, `purok_sitio_id`, `address_purok_id`, `address_label`, `reported_status_key`

select `p`.`purok_id`, `p`.`sitio_id`, `p`.`purok_name`, COUNT(DISTINCT h.household_id) as household_count from `puroks` as `p` inner join `sitios` as `s` on `s`.`sitio_id` = `p`.`sitio_id` left join `addresses` as `a` on `a`.`purok_id` = `p`.`purok_id` and `a`.`purok_id` in (select `eligible_purok`.`purok_id` from `puroks` as `eligible_purok` inner join `sitios` as `eligible_sitio` on `eligible_sitio`.`sitio_id` = `eligible_purok`.`sitio_id` where `eligible_sitio`.`barangay_id` = ?) left join `households` as `h` on `h`.`address_id` = `a`.`address_id` and `h`.`deleted_at` is null where `p`.`sitio_id` in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) group by `p`.`purok_id`, `p`.`sitio_id`, `p`.`purok_name` order by `p`.`purok_name` asc

select a.sitio_id as address_sitio_id, p.sitio_id as purok_sitio_id, a.purok_id as address_purok_id, a.purok_sitio as address_label, COUNT(DISTINCT h.household_id) as households, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hs.status_key IN ('unsafe','needs_help','needs_assistance') THEN h.household_id END) as impacted_households, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hd.needs_dispatch = 1 THEN h.household_id END) as urgent_households, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens device
                WHERE device.household_id = h.household_id AND device.is_active = 1
            ) AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM geotagged_locations location
                WHERE location.household_id = h.household_id
                    AND location.latitude IS NOT NULL AND location.longitude IS NOT NULL
            ) THEN h.household_id END) as no_contact_households from `households` as `h` inner join `addresses` as `a` on `a`.`address_id` = `h`.`address_id` left join `puroks` as `p` on `p`.`purok_id` = `a`.`purok_id` left join `household_disasters` as `hd` on `hd`.`household_id` = `h`.`household_id` and `hd`.`disaster_id` = ? left join `household_statuses` as `hs` on `hs`.`status_id` = `hd`.`current_status_id` where `a`.`purok_id` in (select `eligible_purok`.`purok_id` from `puroks` as `eligible_purok` inner join `sitios` as `eligible_sitio` on `eligible_sitio`.`sitio_id` = `eligible_purok`.`sitio_id` where `eligible_sitio`.`barangay_id` = ?) and `h`.`deleted_at` is null group by `a`.`sitio_id`, `p`.`sitio_id`, `a`.`purok_id`, `a`.`purok_sitio`
